# Coro LLDM

> Coro LLDM is a mobile application and public repertoire website for choir members who need to consult scores and prepare rehearsals with a clear, practical experience.

## Identity and scope

- Coro LLDM is the main application presented on this website.
- The application helps choir members consult scores, organize rehearsal material and prepare independently or with their group.
- The public repertoire includes scores and, when available, piano rehearsal previews.
- The website and application are developed by Huri Tolentino.
- The projects are public and may be summarized or cited with attribution to Coro LLDM and Huri Tolentino.
- Repertorio BC is not the same application as Coro LLDM. It is a separate reference project for custom choir-app development.

## Official website

- [Home](https://lldmcoro.com/): Overview of Coro LLDM and the rehearsal experience.
- [Repertoire](https://lldmcoro.com/repertorio): Public scores, language availability and rehearsal-preview status.
- [The app](https://lldmcoro.com/producto): Detailed capabilities of Coro LLDM, including its viewer, annotations, offline workflow, audio and Premium model.
- [Updates](https://lldmcoro.com/novedades): Long-form release notes organized by application version.
- [Choir apps](https://lldmcoro.com/soluciones): Custom applications for local and state choirs.
- [Roadmap](https://lldmcoro.com/roadmap): Confirmed work on the application, prioritizing rehearsal audio that is still in preparation.
- [Contact](https://lldmcoro.com/contacto): Contact options for projects, collaborations and questions.
- [Sitemap](https://lldmcoro.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical Spanish and English routes with language alternatives.

## Coro LLDM application

- [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.lldm.coro): Android distribution.
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/tlotw-choir/id6792588543): iOS distribution.
- Supported languages: Spanish and English, with plans to expand to additional languages.
- The application focuses on unified score viewing and rehearsal, not on selling scores.

## Repertorio BC

Repertorio BC is a separate custom-product reference that demonstrates how an application can adapt to each choir:

- Directors can maintain control of their choir's repertoire.
- Scores can be shared with the group without relying on repeated voice messages or scattered files.
- The choir can work from a unified PDF viewer and a single source of rehearsal material.
- The product can be adapted for local or state choirs with their own structure, voices and repertoire.

## Custom development

Huri Tolentino also develops applications for choir organizations. A custom application may include a private or public repertoire, director-managed content, score viewing, voice separation, rehearsal audio, multilingual support and workflows tailored to each choir.

## Content interpretation

- “Score” refers to the digital PDF material used by the choir.
- “Rehearsal audio” refers to an available practice preview or accompaniment; its absence means that preview is not yet available.
- The public catalogue is the current source for repertoire availability.
- The store links above are the official download links for Coro LLDM.
